ziel.leer: Please enter an address, e.g. https://homey.home.arpa/api/app/…/dms.
ziel.lang: The address is too long (at most 2000 characters).
ziel.schema: The address must start with https:// (in the home network also http://).
ziel.http: Without TLS (http://) only in the home network, e.g. 192.168.… or ….home.arpa. Otherwise please use https://.
ziel.anmeldung: User name or password don’t belong in the address.
ziel.hash: The address must not have a # part.
ziel.nicht-freigegeben: The destination {ursprung} hasn’t been approved yet. Ask the person who administers Ablago to approve it under Workbench → Webhooks.
tresor.fehlt: The secret can’t be stored encrypted: Ablago’s key is missing (Workbench → Encryption).
admin-abgeschaltet: This webhook has been switched off in the Workbench. Only someone who administers Ablago can switch it on again.
geheimnis.unlesbar: The secret can’t be read (Ablago’s key is missing or doesn’t match). Create a new secret.
fehler.ziel-entzogen: The destination is no longer approved (Workbench → Webhooks).
fehler.weiterleitung: Response {status}: Ablago doesn’t follow redirects. Enter the final address.
abgeschaltet.text:
The webhook “{name}” of {benutzer} couldn’t be reached after {versuche} attempts (about one day) and has now been switched off. Last error: {fehler}

Check the recipient and switch the webhook on again under My account (or under Workbench → Webhooks).
loeschen.folge: Ablago then reports nothing more to this address. The history goes with it.
profil.text: Ablago reports to an address as soon as your numbers change: new post, to do, upcoming and overdue deadlines. That way your home automation (Homey, Node-RED, ioBroker …) reacts instantly. Only numbers are reported – no titles, senders or contents. Several changes in quick succession arrive as one report (at most one every 30 seconds).
profil.name: Name
profil.ziele: Approved destinations: {ziele}. Only https://, in the home network also http://.
profil.ziele.admin: In administration mode you approve the destination when creating it. Only https://, in the home network also http://.
profil.ziele.keine: No destination approved yet. Ask the person who administers Ablago to approve the address under Workbench → Webhooks.
profil.abgeschaltet.fehler: Switched off on {zeit}: the recipient couldn’t be reached for about a day ({text}). Check it and switch the webhook on again.
profil.abgeschaltet.admin: Switched off in the Workbench on {zeit}.
profil.geheimnis.folge: The previous one stops working immediately. Enter the new one at the recipient right away, otherwise it rejects the reports.
profil.geheimnis.einmal: Copy it now and enter it at the recipient – it uses it to check that the report comes from Ablago. It is shown only this once.
werkbank.text: Users can be notified instantly under My account when their numbers change (new post, to do, deadlines) – for example to Homey or Node-RED. Only numbers are reported, never contents, and only to destinations you approve here.
werkbank.ziele.text: One address per line; only the beginning counts (scheme, host, port), e.g. http://homey.home.arpa. Only https://, in the home network also http://. Users can point webhooks only at these destinations. If you remove a destination, Ablago delivers nothing more there.
werkbank.keine: Nobody has created a webhook yet.
werkbank.hinweis: If you switch a webhook off here, only someone who administers Ablago can switch it on again. After about a day without success, Ablago switches a webhook off by itself and emails everyone who manages webhooks.
werkbank.leiste: A webhook has errors or was switched off
